Subject: Ops-ready MAP: initial MAP doc + slide owners (kickoff & ops cadence)

Hi Jane,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation and lots of alignment on the use cases. Per our discussion, I attached an 'ops-ready' MAP template that combines the acceptance criteria, technical validation checklist, and a simple slide-owner matrix so your team can quickly map stakeholders to deliverables.

Requests / next steps:
- Please review the MAP-template-v1.gdoc and add names to the right-hand ownership column for any internal Acme stakeholders.
- Confirm if you want a weekly 30-min sync (recommended) or bi-weekly check-ins during the 30-day proof-of-concept.
- Let me know if procurement should be added to the MAP for the pricing + SOW track; I can template that lane.

I've copied two folks internally who will own technical validation and rollout planning: Marissa Cole (pilot ops) and Aditya Rao (solutions / infra). They will propose the kickoff agenda and a draft timeline once we get your owner list.

Attachments: MAP-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub - editable), MAP-slide-owners.xlsx (sheet for quick owner mapping).

Proposed kickoff: Wed 20 May, 10:00am PT (30 min) — we can adjust.

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Laura —

Thanks for the template, that looks like a clean starting point. A couple of asks from my side: 
1) Can you add a discrete "security & compliance" lane to the MAP? We need to capture SOC2 evidence and data handling expectations up front.
2) Procurement (cc'd) will want the SOW lane to include milestone-based billing points.

I'll add my stakeholder names to the owner matrix by EOD and confirm whether procurement wants weekly or bi-weekly cadence. For the kickoff, Wed 20 May at 10am PT should work; I'll pencil that in.

Thanks — Jane

Appreciate the fast turn, Jane — we will add a security & compliance lane and template the SOC2 evidence checklist row.

Internal owners I propose (feel free to correct):
- Technical validation / infra tests: Aditya Rao
- Pilot ops & acceptance runbook: Marissa Cole
- Commercial / SOW coordination: Stephanie Nguyen

Draft cadence: weekly 30-min sync (Mon mornings) + two deep-dive tech sessions during week 0 and week 2. If procurement prefers milestone billing, Stephanie will add a pricing milestone table into the SOW lane before the kickoff.

Link to editable MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cMAPtemplate

- 10m Pilot runbook & timeline (Marissa)
- 5m Next steps & owners (Laura/Stephanie)

Laura
